name: best customers
description: Top 5 customers ranked by total sales amount over the selected period

name: active customer
description: A customer with at least one order in the last 90 days

name: churned customer
description: A customer with no orders in the last 180 days after having ordered before

name: super routes
description: Delivery routes with more than 100 completed deliveries per month

name: high value order
description: An order whose total amount is above 10000

name: revenue
description: Sum of order total amount excluding tax and cancelled orders

name: average order value
description: Revenue divided by the number of non-cancelled orders

name: repeat purchase rate
description: Share of customers who placed more than one order in the period

name: gross margin
description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold divided by revenue

name: my priority accounts
description: Accounts this user personally tracks: customers tagged as priority
